title: HSK1-HSK4 Learning Path (production-ready)

source_summary.note: conversation_hsk4.json duplicates exactly the HSK4 subset already present in conversation.json.

build_rules: Use prerequisite unlocks, not raw grammar file levels, because some level 1 conversations already depend on level 2 or 3 grammar items.
Teach bridge grammar early when a conversation needs it (e.g. 怎么, 然后, 就, 还, 了2).
Use conversation as the anchor of a module; grammar is taught as the tool to complete the communication task.
Keep all grammar points in the path exactly once as primary focus; later modules may reuse them for review.
HSK3 must include bridge modules because current source only has 3 level-3 conversations.
Use conversation.json as single source of truth and generate conversation_hsk4.json only as an API/cache slice.
Normalize non-ASCII grammar IDs before coding routes or lookup keys (e.g. g_zěnmeyàng -> g_zenmeyang, g_ránhòu -> g_ranhou).

conversationModule.goal: Preview target vocabulary and can-do goal
Read/listen to anchor conversation and check comprehension
Teach second grammar cluster and contrast

bridgeModule.goal: Introduce new structures with short mini-dialogues
Short production task and review quiz
